questions.q: What does a CSV file lack that makes it inefficient for large-scale analytics?
options: Schema, compression, and the ability to read just one column without scanning every row
The ability to be opened in a text editor
Support for numeric values
A file extension
questions.explain: CSV is simple and human-readable, but every query must read entire rows, character by character.

questions.q: What does JSON add on top of CSV?
options: Real structure and nesting — objects can contain arrays and other objects, which CSV cannot express
Built-in compression that CSV lacks
Columnar storage layout
A transaction log
questions.explain: JSON is still row-oriented text like CSV, but it can represent genuinely hierarchical data.

questions.q: What makes Parquet fundamentally different from CSV and JSON?
options: It stores data column-by-column instead of row-by-row, in a compressed binary format with an embedded schema
Parquet is just JSON with a different file extension
Parquet cannot store numeric data
Parquet requires no schema at all, even less than CSV
questions.explain: This columnar layout is what enables column pruning and predicate pushdown.

options: Using stored min/max statistics per column chunk to skip entire chunks that a filter couldn't possibly match, without decompressing them
Pushing a query's WHERE clause to a different server
A method for compressing JSON files
A way to convert CSV files into Parquet automatically
questions.explain: This lets Parquet skip irrelevant data chunks entirely, unlike row-based formats that must scan every row.

questions.q: What does Delta Lake add on top of plain Parquet files?
options: A transaction log tracking every change, enabling ACID transactions, safe concurrent reads/writes, and time travel
A completely different binary format unrelated to Parquet
Delta removes the need for a schema entirely
Delta converts Parquet files back into CSV automatically
questions.explain: Delta tables are still Parquet underneath, with a _delta_log directory tracking transactional history.
